title: Link Compose Relative To Puzzle5d Absolute
description: Make sketchpad Design app a true Puzzle 5D view by implementing compose relative->absolute flatten end-to-end: add connector geometry to compose core, compute absolute piece planes/centers in compose/rs, expose via GraphQL flatPosition, and consume in Design app 2D diagram + 3D scene fixtures.
summary: Implemented end-to-end relative→absolute linking for sketchpad Design app via Puzzle 5D. compose/rs: added Connector geometry (point, direction, t, mandatory) with GraphQL fields and JSON hydration; added design connection hydration wiring parent/child pieces; ported Go flatten algorithm into geom::flatten with BFS spanning forest; Piece.compute_flat_position/flatPosition now returns absolute poses for linked pieces. GraphQL golden schema extended with Connector geometry fields. sketchpad: SKETCHPAD_KIT_READ_INNER now fetches flatPosition and connection transform params; design fixture builders consume absolute flatPosition for 2D diagram centers and 3D scene origin/orientation/scale. Tests: rs flatten_design_resolves_linked_piece_absolute_pose; sketchpad flatPosition fixture and quaternion tests (vitest 3 passed).
